name: cs1.618
purpose: Identity handoff admission for the cs1.618 browser tactical multiplayer FPS. Browser rendering, networking and cryptographic observations are supplied by the named host; this component admits a handoff only when all four checks pass. Send origin, fresh, signature or consent, separated by spaces; it answers allow or deny, and invalid request for anything else.

promise.headline: Says conformant exactly when every policy file matches its lock.
promise.detail: Each of the six universal policy files is compared with the digest the lock records, and any file that drifted is named.

claim: CS-01: the app always answers deny when origin is fail. CS-02: the app always answers deny when fresh is fail. CS-03: the app always answers deny when signature is fail. CS-04: the app always answers deny when consent is fail.

proposition.name: judge
proposition.text:
judge request :=
  origin is pass and fresh is pass and signature is pass and consent is pass → allow
  otherwise → deny
proposition.plain: Identity handoff admission for the cs1.618 browser tactical multiplayer FPS. Browser rendering, networking and cryptographic observations are supplied by the named host; this component admits a handoff only when all four checks pass.
